summary: LDAP is operational on node1 for dc=branch,dc=test. Node2 finds both unchanged users. Anonymous writes fail, authenticated administrator updates succeed, and service/data survived sequential node reboots.
actions_performed: Installed Alpine-compatible OpenLDAP packages without changing the OS release or kernel.
Generated administrator credentials on node1 and configured hashed authentication.
Imported the staged LDIF and enabled slapd at boot.
Verified remote searches and update authorization.
Rebooted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified recovery.

evidence.requirement: Imported identities and mail addresses remain unchanged
evidence.summary: Source and final directory both contain Alex North/alex@branch.test and Sam West/sam@branch.test; final count is two.

evidence.requirement: Node2 can search the people subtree
evidence.summary: Node2 remotely retrieved both users before and after reboots.
Anonymous add failed with authentication-required and created no entry; authenticated administrator add/delete succeeded.
Both nodes remained Alpine 3.23.3 with kernel 6.18.7-0-lts.
Healthy baseline boot 1775cd72…, restart acknowledged, new boot a85b902a…; slapd recovered with both users.
Healthy baseline boot 38f1155a…, restart acknowledged, new boot 1a7bc95e…; remote LDAP search recovered with both users.
